name: nibo.com.br
body: Every internal link that was opened answered, and AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page. But elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds.
lesson: Keep body text at a 4.5:1 contrast ratio or more against its background.
summary: www.nibo.com.br scores 79 out of 100 (C). 2 checks fail now, 28 are at risk, and 29 pass. Fix first: tracking starts on load and no banner asks first.

fix.title: Tracking starts on load and no banner asks first
fix.evidence: No cookie banner appeared. Before any choice, Chromium from an EU address (Belgium) saw HubSpot (4 requests), Meta Pixel (3 requests), LinkedIn Insight (2 requests), Google Ads (2 requests), Taboola (1 request), Google Analytics (1 request), and cookies…
fix.fix: Hold every tag until consent, or set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads. Block third-party embeds until the visitor agrees.

fix.title: Elements must meet minimum color contrast ratio thresholds
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 17 elements on /, /empresa, /empresa/planos-e-precos, for example .link-2. Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Darken the text or lighten the background until normal text reaches 4.5:1 and large text 3:1.

fix.title: Links must have discernible text
fix.evidence: axe-core 4.14.0 found 6 elements on /, /empresa, /empresa/planos-e-precos, for example .a-icon-button.w-inline-block[target="_blank"]:nth-child(1) and .a-icon-button.w-inline-block[target="_blank"]:nth-child(2). Impact: serious.
fix.fix: Give each link text, or an aria-label when it only holds an icon.

fix.title: X-Content-Type-Options is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers may guess a file's type and run it as script. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
Every image has an alt attribute
The chat is light on the start page
Every page has a meta description
